title: AS Watson Group appoints Katinka Ruikes as Managing Director of Kruidvat Belgium
summary: Hong Kong-based health and beauty retailer has announced the appointment of Katinka Ruikes as Managing Director of Kruidvat Belgium, effective 1 January 2027, alongside her current role as Chief Sales & Operations Officer of Kruidvat Netherlands. Katinka Ruikes joined AS Watson in 2009, starting her career in Human Resources and Learning & Development.
